settings.heading: Placing Online Orders
settings.row_content:
Stereo Flower is available to customers 21 years or older.

If you’re of legal age and located in a state where hemp-derived THC beverages can be shipped, you can browse the site, add your favorites to cart, and complete your order at checkout.

Shipping eligibility will be confirmed during checkout based on your location.

settings.heading: How Do I Track An Order I Placed Online?
settings.row_content:
Orders are typically processed and shipped within 1–2 business days after they’re placed.

Once your order is on the way, you’ll receive a shipping confirmation email with tracking details so you can follow it every step of the journey.

If you don’t see your tracking email or have any questions about your order, feel free to reach out to our team at Support@stereoflower.com — we’re here to help.

settings.heading: Can I Cancel An Order I Placed Online?
settings.row_content:
We move quickly to get orders out the door — most begin processing shortly after they’re placed.

Because of this, we’re not able to guarantee cancellations once an order has been submitted. If your order has already entered processing, we won’t be able to stop or modify it.

If you need to request a cancellation, please contact us as soon as possible at support@stereoflower.com with “URGENT: Order Cancellation Request” in the subject line. We’ll do our best to catch it in time.

settings.heading: What is Onward and VIP+ Package Protection?
settings.row_content:
Onward’s VIP+ Package Protection is an optional add-on you can select at checkout to protect your order while it’s in transit.

If your package is lost, stolen, or damaged, VIP+ Package Protection makes it easy to file a claim and get support resolving the issue quickly.

We’ve partnered with Onward to provide an extra layer of assurance, so you’re covered from checkout to delivery.

As an added benefit, every purchase of VIP+ Package Protection helps support environmental initiatives focused on removing CO₂ from the atmosphere and promoting healthier ecosystems.

If you added VIP+ Package Protection to your order and need to file a claim, you can do so through the claims portal.

settings.heading: What If My Stereo Flower Order Arrives Damaged?
settings.row_content:
Onward’s VIP+ Package Protection helps protect your order against issues that can occur during shipping, including damage in transit.

If your order arrives damaged, you can file a claim with Onward for support resolving the issue.

To help speed up the process, we recommend taking photos of both the product and the packaging it arrived in before submitting your claim.

VIP+ Package Protection can be added at checkout for added peace of mind from shipment to delivery.

File a claim with Onward here.

If you did not purchase Onward shipping protection, please send us a message to support@stereoflower.com with a photo of the damaged items as well as the packaging the item arrived in, so we can help.

settings.heading: Missing Or Stolen Orders
settings.row_content:
Onward’s VIP+ Package Protection helps cover orders that are lost or stolen during transit.

To protect your order against loss or theft, be sure to add VIP+ Package Protection at checkout.

settings.heading: Do I have to sign for my delivery?
settings.row_content:
“Adult Signature Required” means your delivery can only be handed off to someone 21 or older, and a signature is needed at the door. The carrier will check a valid government-issued ID to confirm age.

Because Stereo Flower contains THC and is intended for adults, this step is required for all beverage shipments (excluding merchandise) to ensure orders are delivered responsibly and in line with regulations.

settings.heading: QUESTIONS ABOUT SHIPPING
What’s in a Stereo Flower beverage?
settings.row_content:
Each Stereo Flower sparkling tea is made with a tea base, flavor ingredients specific to each variety, hemp-derived THC, CBD, and a functional adaptogen blend featuring L-Theanine, GABA, and Lion’s Mane.

The result is a crisp, refreshing beverage designed to feel balanced, intentional, and easy to enjoy.

settings.heading: What THC options do you offer?
settings.row_content:
Stereo Flower beverages are available in two THC strengths:

5mg THC — a lower-dose option for a more measured experience

10mg THC — a higher-dose option for a more dialed-up experience

Both strengths are available in the same flavors, so you can choose the level that fits your moment without changing the flavor.

settings.heading: Do your drinks contain CBD?
settings.row_content:
Yes. Stereo Flower beverages include CBD alongside THC as part of the overall formulation.

This combination is intended to create a balanced, smooth experience.

settings.heading: What functional ingredients are included?
settings.row_content:
Each can includes:

L-Theanine

GABA

Lion’s Mane

These ingredients are included as part of Stereo Flower’s functional formulation and help set the drinks apart from a more standard THC beverage.

settings.heading: Why does Stereo Flower include L-Theanine, GABA, and Lion’s Mane?
settings.row_content:
Stereo Flower was formulated to be more than just cannabinoids in a can.

We include L-Theanine, GABA, and Lion’s Mane to create a more thoughtful, layered beverage experience that feels intentional from formulation to finish.
